cards.title: NCERT Class 9 Mathematics — Chapter 2: Polynomials
supports: Definition of polynomial in one variable, terms, and coefficients.
Degree of a polynomial as the highest exponent of the variable with a non-zero coefficient.
Degree of a non-zero constant polynomial is zero; degree of the zero polynomial is undefined.
Zeros of a polynomial: a real number c is a zero of p(x) iff p(c) = 0.
Remainder Theorem: When p(x) is divided by (x - a), the remainder is p(a).
Factor Theorem: (x - a) is a factor of p(x) if and only if p(a) = 0.
Factorisation of quadratic polynomials by splitting the middle term.
Geometric area modeling with polynomials and algebraic identities.
Distinction between an algebraic identity (valid for all values) and a conditional equation.

cards.title: OpenStax College Algebra 2e — Chapter 5: Polynomial and Rational Functions
supports: Rational function domains exclude all values that make the denominator zero.
Simplification of rational expressions requires preserving the original domain restriction.
Equality of two functions requires identical domains and identical output values for every point in the domain.
Removable singularities (holes) in graphs vs vertical asymptotes.
Non-zero polynomial degree bounds: a non-zero polynomial of degree n has at most n real roots.

cards.title: OpenStax Precalculus 2e — Polynomial Modeling and Root Reconstruction
supports: Polynomial reconstruction from known zeros: family p(x) = a(x - r_1)(x - r_2)...(x - r_n).
Point evaluation p(x_0) = y_0 uniquely fixes the leading vertical scaling coefficient a.
Division algorithm for polynomials: p(x) = d(x)q(x) + r(x) where deg(r) < deg(d).
